 Emmy and Golden Globe-nominated star Parker Posey joins TODAY to discuss her new role as the host of “The Mob,” a reality competition series from the creators of “The Traitors” where celebrities battle it out. She shares how “White Lotus” fans yell “Piper Noooo!” to her in public after she went viral for demonstrating her character’s accent in Studio 1A and also talks about working with Sam Rockwell and John Malkovich in “Wild Horse Nine.” Oct. 26, 2026
